title: Basic Shapes
introduction: Explore basic shapes through definitions, examples and practice.
definition: A shape describes the outline of an object. A circle is round; a triangle has three straight sides; a square has four equal sides and four right angles.

examples.question: How many sides does a triangle have?

exercises.question: How many straight sides does a square have?
How many straight sides does a circle have?
How many corners does a triangle have?
